question: How big is imbalance in analyzed corpora?

evidence: As expected, we observe a disparity in terms of gender representation in our data (see Table ). Women represent 33.16% of the speakers, confirming the figures given by the GMMP report BIBREF0. However, it is worth noticing that women account for only 22.57% of the total speech time, which leads us to conclude that women also speak less than men.

title: Gender Representation in French Broadcast Corpora and Its Impact on ASR Performance
answer_short: Women are under-represented in terms of speakers and speech turns, with 29.47% of speakers in the Anchor category and 15.9 min of speech time compared to 25.2 min for male Anchors.
answer_rationale: Text 1 and Text 7 provide evidence that women are under-represented in both speaker count and speech turns, particularly in the Anchor category. Text 7 specifically states that women represent 29.47% of Anchor speakers and have 15.9 minutes of speech time compared to 25.2 minutes for male Anchors, indicating a clear imbalance.
